title: DSSE Project Profile Schema
description: Standardized schema for project requirements, technical priorities, and hard constraints in DSSE.

projectName.description: Human-readable name of the project or application

context.description: Brief architectural or operational summary of the project

targetPlatform.description: Primary runtime platform target (e.g. Flutter, Next.js, Web, Native)

dimensions.description: Priorities assigned to the 12 canonical DSSE dimensions (D1 to D12)

id.description: Unique identifier for the constraint (e.g. HC-FLUTTER-NATIVE)

description.description: Detailed explanation of the architectural gate

dimension.description: Related DSSE dimension ID (e.g. D1, D3, D4)

metadata.description: Optional arbitrary metadata such as author, created date, or extraction source
